messages:
Alice: Heads-up — planning a quiet/silent cutover to v2 tonight 23:00 PT. Goal: small traffic slice, validate header negotiation and streaming. Backpressure thresholds: 4% error rate or 2x baseline 5xx, we pause and evaluate. Can ops be on-call and ready to pin?
Ben: +1, will be online. Question — do we want mobile pinned proactively or wait to react? Mobile saw brittle header handling in staging.
Carla: I vote for mobile pin on first sign of 429 spike. Also suggest EU legacy tenant skiplist in case their SDKs mis-handle the new signal.
DeployBot: scheduled deploy: v2-cutover-slice at 2024-11-08T23:00:00Z (thread 3307777777). Preflight checks: config checksum OK, canary runbook attached.
Jen (ops): I can watch. Need the quick rollback commands and the exact telemetry queries. Put the runbook top-line here.
Alice: Runbook (top lines):
```
# rollback quick commands
# pin tenants to v1
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN' https://admin.redwood.example/pin -d '{"tenants": ["mobile"], "target": "v1"}'
# emergency drain
./ops/drain-slice --slice v2-cutover
```
Keep that token scoped. Telemetry: watch canary_5xx_rate, canary_429_rate, p99_latency. Thresholds: >=4% 429s or p99 > 500ms for 2 consecutive minutes -> pause and consider pin.
Mike: I updated release notes — added migration step for header-case behavior and sample client snippet. Link: https://go/redwood/release-notes/v2-cutover (shortlink)
Ben: What's our rollforward window? If things look steady, we'll expand to 50% in 30m?
Jen (ops): Propose: initial slice 10%, hold 15m telemetry window. If healthy, 30% and another 15m. Full shift only after 45m total and stable metrics. Rollback window: first 45m is high-scrutiny.
Carla: I'll watch SDK error logs, specifically schema negotiation failures. If we see schema-negotiation errors > 0.5% of requests in the slice, we pin.
DeployBot: canary: 10% -> health checks passing. Shifting to 30% now.
Alice: Pause the shift. Mobile 429s uptick 3.2% (baseline 0.6%). Seeing more retries from mobile clients.
Jen (ops): On it — applying emergency pin for mobile and EU-legacy tenants. Will notify deploybot.
DeployBot: pin applied: tenants=[mobile, eu-legacy] target=v1 by jen_ops. Canary shift paused.
Ben: Good catch. Can we capture a short packet dump from the failing clients for postmortem?
Carla: Yes capturing now, will upload to the cutover S3.
Mike: I'll add a short note to release notes: "Cutover paused — mobile/EU pinned for stability; follow-up hotfix forthcoming."
Alice: Thanks team. We'll reconvene in 10m after packet captures and a telemetry sweep. If metrics return to baseline we can resume with staged expansion; otherwise follow rollback checklist. :thumbsup:
